_comment: Independent witness for teleport.c tele_trap()'s occupied fixed destination: a level-1 Teleportation hub sends the trap at <70,15> to <69,4>. The hero teleports beside that destination, drops a dagger, waits three turns and creates a sessile green mold, which lands on the destination; the hero then teleports beside the trap and steps onto it. enexto() moves the mold off the destination, rloc_to() places it, and teleds() lands the hero, with the dagger in the destination's first ring.
